turns.customer: I think I have around 900 Pet Points. How much will that take off my next stay?
blocks:
Happy Tails’ published rewards terms give **$5 in credit for every 250 points**, redeemable at checkout in $5 increments. If your balance is exactly 900 points, that would mean **$15 off**; the remaining 150 points wouldn’t make another $5 credit yet. Credits can be used for any service or pet on your account, but they can’t be used for retail purchases and expire one year after they’re earned.

Since you said “around” 900, check your exact balance in the **Gingr customer portal** before your stay.
